overview.en:
Connect Cisco’s official Webex MCP services for meetings, team messaging, Vidcast videos and workspace intelligence.

Bring messages and collaboration context into a focused work brief. Specify the team, conversation, or project and prepare responses from the information actually returned.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
连接思科官方 Webex MCP，处理会议、团队消息、Vidcast 视频及工作空间设备洞察。

把消息与协作上下文整理成聚焦的工作简报。明确团队、会话或项目，并依据实际返回的信息准备回复。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Find the recent discussion about this project and summarize its decisions.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查找这个项目的近期讨论，汇总已作出的决策。

starterPrompts.en: List the open questions and follow-up items from this conversation.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 列出这段会话中的待确认问题与后续事项。

starterPrompts.en: Draft a team update using the available conversation context.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 根据可用会话上下文起草团队进度更新。

descriptions.en: Use Webex in Ghast. Connect Cisco’s official Webex MCP services for meetings, team messaging, Vidcast videos and workspace intelligence. 连接思科官方 Webex MCP，处理会议、团队消息、Vidcast 视频及工作空间设备洞察。
